description: Dynamically proposes cross-asset statistical mean-reversion strategies from point-in-time correlation and half-life evidence, then hands them to the shared deterministic Backtest Engine for evaluation.
implementation_notes: src/agents/quant_trader implements agents.base.TraderAgent structurally; see docs/quant_trader.md for the full design.

data_service now resolves to the real shared services.data_service.DataService (YFinanceDataService/YFinanceBacktestDataResolver); examples/run_demo.py wires it in directly. validation_split_policy is still a provisional team-owned boundary (docs/implementation_boundaries.md).

src/agents/quant_trader/examples/static_data_service.py retains Quant Trader's earlier dev-only DataService/BacktestDataResolver stand-ins (yfinance, Financial Modeling Prep, Stooq, Alpha Vantage, static xlsx), commented out, as fallbacks only - not used by default.
Interpretation is currently template-generated (interpretation.py), not model-authored; no model_client dependency is wired in yet.
